thread:
Ravi: hi team \ putting this in a private thread. i'm starting gender-affirming care soon and will need a short medical leave (2 weeks) later this quarter, plus a few follow-up clinic days. i'm also requesting: 1) name/pronoun update across systems before i return, 2) no customer-facing duties for 6 weeks after surgery, 3) temporary workload reduction (reassign 20% of my tasks), and 4) confidentiality about medical details. im nervous about the midcycle review and want to avoid any negative mention. what are next steps?

Ken - Manager: Ravi  thank you for telling us. fully support you. we'll cover customer calls and swap tasks. i won't add any subjective notes to your review; we'll work with People Ops on an accommodation letter. happy to be limited to "medical leave and temporary duty reassignment" in manager notes. :heart:

Marta - People Ops: hi Ravi  thanks for flagging and congrats on taking this step. standard flow: private interactive conversation, draft a time-limited accommodation letter (leave duration, reduced duties, no customer-facing tasks), coordinate with People Ops/HR to update name/pronouns across systems, and file confidential HR records. provider note helps for leave but is optional for name/pronoun changes. can we schedule a 30m private call today?

Ravi: thanks Marta. yes to the call. i want name/pronouns updated before i come back so teammates don't have to ask. also prefer that the announcement to my team be written and only say: "Ravi will be on medical leave; outreach for coverage has been arranged."

Zoe - HR: Ravi  we can do that. steps for name/pronoun update: 1) update HRIS and AD display name, 2) alias email if needed, 3) Slack display name and profile fields changed on your behalf if you consent, 4) badge/ID update with facilities. we can queue this to happen the day before your return. we'll also provide a confidential accommodation letter documenting leave, duty reassignment, and customer-facing restrictions. this will not be added to performance notes beyond factual dates.

Ben: happy to cover customer meetings and take over your oncall rotation for the 6-week window. ping me which recurring calls to move.

Marta - People Ops: draft accommodation template we can use (quick):

```
Accommodation plan (draft):
- Leave: 2 weeks medical leave (dates TBD) + up to 3 clinic/travel days
- Duties: temporary reassignment of 20% of task load; no customer-facing meetings for 6 weeks post-return
- Systems: coordinated name/pronoun updates (HRIS, Slack, email alias, badge) to occur prior to return
- Privacy: medical details retained in HR confidential file; team communication limited to status-only message
- Performance: offer review window extension or reweighting for affected cycle; no subjective performance notes related to leave
```

Marta - People Ops: if that looks good i'll put this into a formal accommodation letter and coordinate with facilities, recruiting (if we need coverage), and IT for the name changes.

Ravi: that template is perfect. i don't want the team to have details. yes please coordinate the name updates and the public message template.

Ken - Manager: i'll hold off on nominating you for the midcycle stretch assignment and will request the reweighting for your review.

Zoe - HR: next steps: 1) 30m private call to agree dates and wording, 2) Marta will draft accommodation and confidentially file it, 3) IT/facilities will queue name/pronoun changes for the return date, 4) Ken + Ben will update schedules and meetings.

Ravi: thank you everyone. appreciate the speed and discretion. i'll take the call this afternoon.

Marta - People Ops: DM'ing invite now. all sensitive info stays in HR's secure record. :lock:
